title: WorkoutPlan
description: JSON Schema for workout plans with Warmup, Main, Core, and Finisher sections

planName.description: Name of the workout plan (e.g., 'Week 12 — Modified Athletic Cut & Core')

description.description: Overview and primary goals of the workout program

goals.description: List of fitness, body composition, or performance targets

principles.description: Progression principles, intensity guidelines (RIR), tempo, and recovery rules

routines.description: Dictionary of routine/day names mapped to sectioned workouts (warmup, main, core, finisher) or exercise lists

oneOf.description: Sectioned routine format with Warmup, Main, Core, and Finisher

main.description: Primary strength, pull, push, or leg compound exercises

core.description: Core stability, compression, pelvic tilt, or isometric hold exercises

skill.description: Optional skill practice movements (Handstand, L-Sit, Pistol Squats)

finisher.description: Metabolic conditioning circuits, intervals, or endurance finishers

recovery.description: Set to true for active recovery or full rest days

routine.description: Light activity items for recovery days (e.g. 8k steps, mobility)

reflection.description: Weekly recovery metrics to record (sleep, soreness, measurements)

cue.description: Mental cue or form reminder for the session

oneOf.description: Flat exercise list format with optional section property

targetReps.description: Target rep range or hold duration (e.g., '3-5 reps', '30-45s', '10-12/leg')

restSeconds.description: Rest duration in seconds after each set

notes.description: Execution cues, tempo, or RIR targets (e.g., '1-2 RIR', '6s descent')

section.description: Section category when using flat array format
